user.title: PV surplus for the heat pump
user.description: Pick the entities from EMS-ESP, grid meter, battery and optionally the PV forecast. After setup the integration starts in observe mode: it calculates and logs, but writes nothing to the heat pump.

data.name: Name
data.price_entity: Electricity price sensor (optional, for dynamic / time-of-use tariffs)
data.evu_entity: EMS-ESP input option for the EVU block (optional, e.g. hpin1opt)
data.backup_reserve_entity: Battery backup reserve in % (optional, for peak mode)
data.hourly_price_entity: Current hourly price (optional, for peak mode)
data.avg_price_entity: Average price today (optional, for peak mode)

data_description.name: Display name of the device.
data_description.signal_entity: Text entity holding the bit pattern of the SG/PV input. The selected bit is set to 1 for PV mode (as in the evcc template: 1xxxxxxxxxxx = boost).
data_description.signal_bit: 0 = first character. Usually 0 for PV/SG4 on Buderus/Bosch/Junkers.
data_description.grid_entity: Power at the grid connection point.
data_description.pvmaxcomp_entity: EMS-ESP entity pvmaxcomp. Adjusted to the surplus during PV mode.
data_description.hp_power_entity: EMS-ESP entity hpcurrpower (electrical power). Needed for compressor power control.
data_description.price_entity: Current electricity price, e.g. from Tibber, Nord Pool, EPEX Spot or Octopus. Leave empty without a dynamic tariff – then there are no price settings.
data_description.price_unit: “Automatic” detects €/kWh, ct/kWh and €/MWh from the sensor. Only change it if the sensor has no unit. Applies to all price sensors.
data_description.evu_entity: Peak mode: text entity holding the bit pattern of the EVU input. The selected bit is set to 1 while the price is high and the battery is empty (e.g. 1xxxxxxxxxxxxxx = EVU block); the other characters stay unchanged. Only together with backup reserve, hourly price and average price.
data_description.evu_bit: 0 = first character. Usually 0 for the EVU block on Buderus/Bosch/Junkers.
data_description.backup_reserve_entity: Reserve the battery does not go below. The EVU block is possible once the state of charge is at most reserve + margin.
data_description.hourly_price_entity: €/kWh or ct/kWh, e.g. Tibber “Hourly price current”.
data_description.avg_price_entity: €/kWh or ct/kWh, e.g. Tibber “Average price today”.

error.hp_power_required: Compressor power control also needs the current compressor power.
error.price_unit_unknown: The unit of the price sensor was not recognised. Please choose the unit below manually.
error.peak_incomplete: Peak mode needs all four fields: EVU input, backup reserve, hourly price and average price.

abort.already_configured: This input entity is already set up.
